name: Painterly styles (gouache, ink miniature, clean toon)
what: Turns an ordinary three.js scene into one of three art styles that switch live and are remembered: a painterly gouache (Kuwahara brush sized by distance, pigment at stroke edges, world-space strokes, paper tooth, warm light and cool shade, painted cumulus sky), an ink-outlined miniature painting (flat jewel palette, ink from depth silhouettes and creases, paper, ruled border, curling contour clouds) and a clean toon (two-step light, pastel layered fog, soft outlines). Materials are patched to flat palette-snapped colour with the style's light ramp; one post pass paints the rest.
use_when: the game wants a painted, illustrated, ink or toon look, or a player-selectable art style, on an existing three.js scene without remaking its materials

third_party.what: three.js and its addons (FullScreenQuad, UnrealBloomPass, Neutral tone mapping chunk)
third_party.author: three.js authors

good_for: Outdoor or indoor three.js scenes built from MeshStandardMaterial that should look painted or illustrated; games that want a Look setting (Painterly / Miniature / Clean / Classic) switched live with no recompile; flying, exploring and racing games with long views (the haze and sky are a big part of it).
not_for: Orthographic or 2D games (needs a perspective depth buffer); custom ShaderMaterial worlds (they are not repainted); very weak phones (gouache adds ~1.7 ms at 720p on a Mac, several times that on low-end GPUs); pixel-art or photoreal looks.
